source_limitations: Official Oxford 3000 and 5000 CEFR PDFs directly inspected 2026-10-31. Nine entries have exact PDF word/POS level and line/page evidence; server noun was not found in either inspected core list, which is NOT a CEFR classification. Five official dictionary pages directly inspected; their sense descriptions and topic badges are not independent exact-sense CEFR evidence. All ten entries and rewrites remain unapproved; no final George/Emma audio listening, physical iPhone, hosting or production deployment evidence.
